Verification Requirement: Verify MFA is enabled for privileged AWS accounts
Expected Result: All privileged accounts have MFA enabled
Evidence Required: IAM configuration export or console evidence

Verification Requirement: Verify root account is not used for routine administration
Expected Result: Root account is restricted to exceptional activities

Verification Requirement: Verify user permissions follow least privilege
Expected Result: Permissions are limited to approved job responsibilities
Evidence Required: IAM policies and access review records

Verification Requirement: Verify inactive accounts are identified and disabled
Expected Result: Inactive accounts are reviewed and addressed
Evidence Required: User account inventory and review records

Verification Requirement: Verify access keys are managed securely
Expected Result: Unnecessary or exposed access keys are removed or rotated

Verification Requirement: Verify production databases are not publicly accessible
Expected Result: Database access is restricted to approved network paths

Verification Requirement: Verify inbound security group rules are restricted
Expected Result: Only approved ports and sources are permitted

Verification Requirement: Verify administrative access is restricted
Expected Result: Administrative access is limited to approved access paths

Verification Requirement: Verify public access to private storage is blocked
Expected Result: Private storage resources are not publicly accessible

Verification Requirement: Verify encryption at rest for sensitive data
Expected Result: Restricted and Confidential data stores use approved encryption

Verification Requirement: Verify sensitive data transfers use encryption in transit
Expected Result: Sensitive data transfers use approved secure protocols
Evidence Required: TLS configuration or security test evidence

Verification Requirement: Verify cloud administrative activity logging is enabled
Expected Result: Relevant administrative activities are recorded

Verification Requirement: Verify logs are protected against unauthorised modification
Expected Result: Log access and deletion permissions are restricted

Verification Requirement: Verify security alerts are configured for relevant events
Expected Result: Relevant suspicious activities generate alerts

Verification Requirement: Verify cloud workloads are included in vulnerability assessments
Expected Result: In-scope workloads are assessed according to the vulnerability management schedule

Verification Requirement: Verify critical vulnerabilities are tracked and remediated
Expected Result: Remediation follows approved timelines

Verification Requirement: Verify critical data is covered by approved backups
Expected Result: Backup coverage matches defined business requirements

Verification Requirement: Verify backup restoration tests are performed
Expected Result: Restoration tests are documented and reviewed

Verification Requirement: Verify significant cloud changes are approved
Expected Result: Changes have documented approval and implementation records

Verification Requirement: Verify cloud configurations are reviewed periodically
Expected Result: Configuration reviews are performed at defined intervals

Verification Requirement: Verify AWS and CloudLedger responsibilities are documented
Expected Result: Responsibilities are mapped to the actual AWS services used

Verification Requirement: Verify cloud security incidents can be reported and escalated
Expected Result: Cloud incidents follow the approved incident response process
Evidence Required: Incident response procedure and incident records
